builds.name: Surround Sound: one missing-health recovery pulse
builds.summary: Investigate high one Surround Sound self-heal pulse output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Surround Sound self-heal pulse output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The heal helper is 8/10/12/14/16% recipient missing health, delayed 2.5 seconds when the shield prerequisite is met. This source helper has no direct AP coefficient or explicit nearby-ally count multiplier. For a self-heal, purchased maximum HP can enlarge the deficit while eligible heal modifiers increase recovery; W shield capacity is separate.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy (not the self-heal recipient): 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 10%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Owner 10% health, exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP. Prepare Echo through two legitimate basic casts so W is the third basic ability and echoes; confirm the first W shield legally enables a heal from the echoed cast. Score exactly one observed self-heal pulse after 2.5 seconds, within a three-second window. No external shield or new damage/healing during the wait.

kitEvidence.formula:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them [(0.2 + (0.0002) × AP) × (0.4)] Move Speed, herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] decaying Move Speed and both [(60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.2) × AP) × (1)] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring [8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16]% missing Health to them after a [2.5] second delay.
